stem.en: A car of mass 1000 kg starts from rest and reaches 72 km/h in 10 s. What is the average power of its engine, in watts? (Convert the speed to m/s first, and ignore friction and air.)

explanation.en: 72 km/h is 72 x 1000 / 3600 = 20 m/s. The engine's work is the car's final kinetic energy: 1/2 x 1000 x 20^2 = 200 000 J. Power is that work over the time: 200 000 / 10 = 20 000 W. Forgetting to convert the speed gives an answer wrong by a factor of about 13.

hints.en: Convert the speed to metres per second before squaring it.
The car starts at rest, so the work done is its final kinetic energy. Then divide by the time.
